observations: Photo 0 shows a wall/room rechargeable-style fan with a circular grille and 3-blade propeller, plus a separate battery/charging unit mounted/attached on the right.
Photo 1 shows the same fan more clearly; the center hub has a logo/mark that is not fully readable, and the battery/charging unit is visible on the right.
No clear label/model number is readable on the fan or battery unit in the provided photos.
No power-on test, battery indicator, or runtime measurement is shown.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: The photos show a fan with a logo on the hub, but the brand name 'Qasa' is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low...
claims.evidence: No battery runtime test, charge indicator, or powered-on timer is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Battery capacity may be degraded, so runtime could be much shorter than claimed.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running from full charge with a visible timer (e.g., phone stopwatch) and battery/charge indicator if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used rechargeable fan with unknown/possibly reduced runtime (worst case: not meeting the claimed 2 hours).

risks.risk: Fan may have speed/control issues (e.g., low speed not working, abnormal noise, wobble).
risks.proof: A short power-on video showing all speed settings (low/medium/high) and steady operation without unusual noise/vibration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing service or with uncertain performance (worst case: only basic operation).

risks.risk: Battery/charging unit may be missing parts or may not charge properly.
risks.proof: A photo/video of the charging process: plug-in to power source, charging indicator light changes, and confirmation it charges to full.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to charge reliably (worst case: charging issues).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in photos (cracked grille, bent blades, motor wear).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of blades, grille, and motor hub plus a running video from different angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cosmetic/functional wear (worst case: needs inspection).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the brand/model label on the fan hub and/or battery unit (so we can confirm 'Qasa' and exact model).
Record a video: charge to full (show indicator), then run on low and high with a visible timer to confirm runtime.
Show the charging unit plugged in and charging indicator behavior (and confirm it reaches full).
Show a power-on test video demonstrating all speed settings and steady operation (no wobble/noise).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a rechargeable fan, but the key pricing drivers (exact brand/model and verified battery runtime/charging condition) are not readable or test-proven in the images.
